cases.paper: Duval, Klivans, and Martin, Simplicial Matrix-Tree Theorems
locators: PDF p. 1 / extracted lines 18-47: graph domain, n-c nonzero eigenvalues, connected classical theorem
PDF p. 2 / extracted lines 74-107: weighted Laplacian and Theorem 1.2
cases.error_class: indexed-spectrum expression changed into product over nonzero eigenvalues
cases.material_precision: Theorem 1.2 is stated without a connectedness assumption. It omits one designated zero and multiplies the remaining n-1 indexed eigenvalues; extra zeros remain when disconnected. The slogan's product over only nonzero eigenvalues is different.
freeze_before_encoding: positive rational conductances for executable specialization
source product omits one designated zero but not every zero
weighted spanning-tree mass and every one-row/one-column cofactor
cases.known_example: Two disjoint unit edges have spectrum 0,0,2,2; product of nonzero eigenvalues divided by n is 1, while tree mass and any reduced determinant are 0.

cases.paper: Chung and Zeng, Forest formulas of discrete Green's functions
locators: PDF p. 5 / extracted lines 258-282: forest weight and tau
PDF p. 15 / extracted lines 1141-1154: conductance and Corollary 4.7
cases.error_class: weighted tree masses changed into ordinary tree counts
cases.material_precision: The source uses tau and tau_e as sums of products of weights. The slogan retains a weighted graph but calls them numbers of trees, changing the formula for nonunit conductances.
freeze_before_encoding: finite connected loop-free weighted undirected graph
edge e has distinct endpoints and positive conductance
tau is the sum over trees of products of conductances
tau_e is the weighted sum restricted to trees containing e
effective resistance uses reciprocal edge resistance and exact rational arithmetic
claim distinguishes weighted masses from ordinary cardinalities
cases.known_example: Triangle conductances (2,1,1), weight-2 edge: tau=5, tau_e=4, R_eff=2/5, while ordinary counts give 2/(3*2)=1/3.

comparison.reason: The first probes multiplicity/index semantics and disconnected exact linear algebra. The second probes weighted measure versus ordinary count on a connected positive-conductance graph.
comparison.shared_limit: Both labels and examples were disclosed. Passing demonstrates executable reuse and review discipline, not discovery.
